# Anim

Use this skill when the user asks for motion design on a web page.

## Steps

1. Pick the elements to animate.
2. Write the timeline with Anime.js.
3. Check the result in the browser.

Keep each animation short so that the page stays readable for every visitor.

Example: animate an SVG logo on page load.

Limitations: the skill does not cover 3D scenes.
